propositions: A PreToolUse hook on the Bash tool must emit a short reminder (2–3 lines) whenever grep-family commands (grep, rg, egrep, fgrep) are invoked, promoting Serena's symbol tools while acknowledging legitimate grep use cases (strings, line numbers).
The hook trigger is a simple string match for grep-family commands with no pattern classification, path heuristics, or command parsing; false positives are accepted as a design trade-off.
The hook is non-blocking: it emits JSON with additionalContext to inform the model but omits permissionDecision, allowing the grep command to execute normally and unchanged.
The hook is implemented as a tracked, testable script (scripts/hooks/serena_grep_reminder.py) rather than inline JSON, so trigger and message can be validated by automated test.
The PreToolUse entry must be merged into .claude/settings.json without overwriting story C's env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH setting, and depends on story C for .gitignore negation to make .claude/ trackable.
Automated tests verify the hook fires on grep and rg commands, does not fire on non-grep commands, never blocks, and never exits non-zero even with malformed input.
